freePlan.limits: Limited number of personal files, unlimited viewers, access to the community asset library, web exports carry a watermark.

keyLimits.en: Limited personal files, unlimited viewers, community asset library, watermarked web exports.
Unlimited files, 2,000 monthly AI credits included; annual billing saves $36/seat/year (2 months free) versus monthly.
3,000 monthly AI credits included, progressively unlocks iOS/Android/GLTF/USDZ/STL export formats; annual billing saves $60/seat/year.
10,000 monthly AI credits included, 5x more media generation per week than lower tiers; annual billing saves $120/seat/year.
Custom AI credit allotment, adds code exports and self-hosted deployment options; annual billing only, custom quote.

cautions.en: AI credits (image/media generation) are metered separately per plan and can be a hidden cost driver beyond the base seat price.

capabilities.en: Real-time collaborative 2D and 3D scene creation with modeling, texturing and animation tools in the browser.
Interactive publishing: exported scenes respond to user input (mouse, scroll, events) for embedding in web experiences.
AI-assisted media generation (credits-based) for textures, materials or assets within the editor.
Export to multiple formats depending on plan, including GLTF, USDZ, STL and native iOS/Android integration on higher tiers.

limitations.en: Free plan limits the number of personal files and adds a watermark to web exports.
Code exports and self-hosted deployment are Enterprise-only, unavailable on Hobby/Pro/Max plans.

reason.en: Full-featured free 3D creation suite, a common alternative for 3D modeling and animation work.
Interactive web design tool that overlaps with Spline for building interactive, animated web experiences.
Real-time interactive animation tool, direct competitor for embeddable interactive graphics.
